description: Verify that DUT-emitted ARP Probes carry sender_proto_ip = 0.0.0.0 (RFC 3927 §2.1.1, MUST)
approach:
[Objective]
RFC 3927 §2.1.1 requires Probes to set ARP sender_proto_ip = 0.0.0.0 — the prober has not yet committed an IP, so any non-zero value would mislead conflict detection or pollute receivers' ARP caches. This case observes the first DUT-emitted Probe and asserts sender_proto_ip is all zeroes.

[Scenario — chronological]
1. Tester → DUT: OpStartLLAutoconf (kicks the Link-Local state machine)

2. Observation:
   • DUT → wire: ARP Probe (the first one)
     - ARP sender_proto_ip == 0.0.0.0   ← key check

[Pass condition]
First DUT Probe carries ARP sender_proto_ip = 0.0.0.0.

[Fail condition]
• Fail_sender_proto_ip_nonzero — Probe sender_proto_ip is not 0.0.0.0 (would falsely advertise an IP DUT has not claimed)
• Fail_timeout — DUT did not emit any ARP Probe within the deadline

verdicts.Fail_timeout: DUT did not emit any ARP Probe within the deadline
